paragraphs.text: Pegasus is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of winged horses .
Pegasi are primarily white -aligned, though Tizerus Charger is mono- black .
The type is based on the Pegasus of Greek mythology .
The first card to bear the type was Mesa Pegasus in Alpha . Sacred Mesa in Mirage created Wild Pegasus tokens, but that was already consolidated into Pegasus for the Anthologies release.
Modern Horizons 2 printed the first non-white pegasus was Tizerus Charger . Streets of New Capenna printed the first multicolored pegasus, Park Heights Pegasus .
The silver-bordered Ponies: The Galloping 2 set featured two pegasi in Fluttershy and Rainbow Dash (the first pegasus with in its color identity and cost).
Pegasi can be found on Dominaria , Ravnica , and especially on the Greek-inspired plane of Theros .
In the city of New Capenna , the plane's few remaining pegasi can be found as luxury pets in the Park Heights district.

The most famous pegasi on Dominaria live in eastern Aerona , near the village of Sursi . According to the local custom, Sursi brides-to-be visit their territory, hoping a pegasus will judge her worthy and bless her and her family.
In the Ice Age , the Order of Stromgald used huge war steeds which sometimes could fly ( Stromgald Crusader ). In Jamuraa , Pegasi are preyed upon by the Giant Mantis .

A small number of pegasi existed on Rath , although it is implied that they did not much like it there. After the planar overlay, it can be assumed that any surviving Rathi pegasi continued to survive on Dominaria.

The pegasi of Ravnica, as far as can be told, are all wild. Although, surprisingly, such a useful animal could survive on the city plane without being domesticated by someone, there is no evidence that they have ever been tamed. Equenauts of Selesnya Conclave ride pegasi, combining the role of mounted warriors and scouts ( Conclave Equenaut , Flight of Equenauts ). However, Gideon Jura rode a pegasus called Promise in his attack on Nicol Bolas .

Pegasi are very common on Theros. Unlike those of other planes, Therosian pegasi are often used as mounts or hitched to flying chariots. (In the Theros block, only Gild depicts a pegasus without harness or rider.)
Pegasi are the favorite mount of military commanders ( Vryn Wingmare ).

Mechanically, the Pegasus tends to be one of the smaller white flying creatures, with total power and toughness usually less than 5 and a mana value of 4 or less. The largest Pegasus is Pegasus Guardian , a six-mana 3/3.
